n386c6bbdce.headline: The President noted high investor interest in the privatization program of "Samruk-Kazyna"
n386c6bbdce.summary: At a board meeting led by President Nazarbayev, Kazakhstan's National Welfare Fund Samruk-Kazyna discussed its updated development strategy and transformation program amid strong investor interest.
n386c6bbdce.why: Samruk-Kazyna is Kazakhstan's sovereign wealth fund managing key state assets; its privatization plans impact the country's economic reform and investment climate.

na0868a0bb9.headline: Kazakhstan's revenues from alcohol excise taxes increased 1.5 times
na0868a0bb9.summary: Kazakhstan collected 10.9 billion tenge in alcohol excise taxes in January-February 2018, a 48.4% increase from the same period last year.
na0868a0bb9.why: Excise tax revenues are a key source of government income and reflect consumption trends in the alcohol sector, impacting fiscal policy and sector regulation.
